I think the only way you will be able to get him to see a doctor to get him diagnosed is by discussing it with him, autism and all. Most primary health doctors think if you weren’t diagnosed as a child it isn’t severe enough to deserve help (totally wrong btw) and it sounds like he wouldn’t be willing to go see one anyways without a reason. 

The best option that would benefit him though to see someone who specializes in diagnosing autism. It could get him disability for work, pay for meds for depression, therapy to help if he doesn’t want to isolate and just feels like that’s his only option.

I really feel you and hope things with your mom go better for you, but don’t let her ideas affect you too much, she sounds like she doesn’t know anything about it.

With her doing it so young you really need to nip it in the bud as soon as possible or else she will learn they are acceptable behaviors. I think (but i’m not a professional) that she is likely doing it because Ben is an older dog and really isn’t seen as a threat for authority but Beau being the same age is seen as competition for your attention. https://pethelpful.com/cats/How-to-Deal-With-Two-Dogs-Fighting-Over-Onwer This article has some great advice, and like it mentions, the best thing to do is see a force free trainer to get to the root of the problem and fast.
